text:
maria: Heads up — vendor sync planned for next Wed 09:00 PT. Goal: align on H100/H200/B200, MI300, Gaudi timelines and marketplace listing windows + embargo handoffs. Who can join?

kevin: I can make it. Will need the release calendar from eng-releases and SRE availability. Any infra blockers?

sachin: Runtime update: H100 kernel tweaks still in QA. If microcode or CUDA bits slip we may see a 1–2 week delay on the H100 image. Flagging now.

alice: Marketplace note: AWS requires ~2w lead for listing tests, Azure/GCP ~3w. We also need final image tags and cert bundles before submitting.

maria: @alice can you open marketplace tickets and capture lead times per cloud? Also need vendor embargo dates — partners asked for one canonical timeline. We have a tentative H200 GA date from partner email.

jessica: From partner comms: NVIDIA tentatively GA H200 in window 2026-05-08 → 05-10; they requested embargo lift on 2026-05-05. NVIDIA confirmed H100 microcode still TBD. AMD MI300 is tentatively 2026-05-20 per their channel. Habana/Gaudi partner only said "mid-May" (no firm date yet).

kevin: Actionable: plan routing/fallback for hosted API — prefer H100, fallback to H200, then B200. If H100 image slips, we should auto-route to H200 for latency SLA. Can SRE draft a runbook?

sachin: On runtime we’ll prepare a quantized B200 build as a fallback. Expect perf delta ~+15% latency vs H100. Will run perf/regression tests and post results.

alice: I'll file the cloud tickets today. Quick checklist I'll include: image tags, certs, marketplace test account, embargo window, press contact.

maria: Consolidated action items:
1) @alice open marketplace tickets + share timeline per cloud
2) @kevin SRE runbook + fallback routing (draft by Tue 2026-05-05 EOD PT)
3) @sachin perf/regression plan for B200 quant builds + test results in eng-runtime
4) @maria schedule vendor sync and distribute invite + canonical timeline

kevin: Noted. Runbook ETA Tue 2026-05-05 EOD PT. I'll include rollback steps and traffic-shift snippets.

sachin: Perf tests scheduled Wed–Fri next week, I'll push a summary to #eng-runtime and link here.

announce-bot: Reminder: Partner sync created for Wed 2026-05-06 09:00 PT — https://meet.redwood.ai/abc123

maria: Thanks — invite sent to partners. If you can't make it please DM notes or add an agenda item here. :thumbsup:

maria: Quick timeline snippet below (for the vendor sync doc):
```
H100: vendor GA = 2026-05-08 (embargo lift 2026-05-05)
H200: GA = 2026-05-10
MI300: GA = 2026-05-20
Gaudi: target mid-May (TBD)
Marketplaces: AWS +2w, GCP +3w, Azure +3w
Fallback order: H100 -> H200 -> B200 (quantized)
```

kevin: Adding runbook snippet to agenda: 
```
# traffic-shift example
POST /route-policy
{ "from": "H100", "to": "H200", "percent": 100 }
```

alice: Filed AWS/GCP/Azure tickets and added expected lead times. I'll post links after partner sync.

maria: Great — will close the loop on embargo wording with partners after the meeting. If any vendor gives a hard date earlier than listed, ping the channel immediately.

kevin: Also recommend a short internal freeze window for deploys during 05/04–05/12 to avoid accidental rollouts. Thoughts?

sachin: Agree — will block E2E test lanes and schedule extra perf runs during that window.

maria: Consensus on freeze window. I'll add to the invite notes. Thanks all.
